To install sshtunnel, you can use pip, easy_install, or conda. Simply run `pip install sshtunnel`, `easy_install sshtunnel`, or `conda install -c conda-forge sshtunnel`. For installing from source, clone the repository and run `python setup.py install`. The package version is 0.4.0.
To install the sshtunnel Python package, you can use pip, easy_install, or conda. The sources indicate that you can run `pip install sshtunnel`, `easy_install sshtunnel`, or `conda install -c conda-forge sshtunnel` to install it. For installing from source, clone the repository and run the necessary setup commands. The sshtunnel package version mentioned in the sources is 0.5.1.
To install the sshtunnel Python package, you can download the source distribution from PyPI. The latest version available is 0.0.7, which can be downloaded as sshtunnel-0.0.7.tar.gz. To install, you can use pip: `pip install sshtunnel-0.0.7.tar.gz`. The package supports Python 2 and 3, and includes various features such as SSH tunnel creation, remote bind address configuration, and local bind address configuration. The sshtunnel package is maintained on GitHub at https://github.com/pahaz/sshtunnel.
